What is PPDA? PPDA measures how many passes a team allows in its defensive/middle thirds for each defensive action (tackle, interception, pressure, foul). • Low PPDA = aggressive high press • High PPDA = deeper, conservative block

Statistical models analyze various factors by comparing each shot to thousands of similar situations found in historical data. The result is a probability score, an xG value, which ranges from 0 to 1. This score indicates how likely it was for the shot to result in a goal.

xG models consider a wide range of inputs to assess the quality of a chance, including: - Distance to goal - Angle the shot is taken from - Type of shot (foot, header) - Goalkeeper’s position - Number and position of defenders - Context of play (open play, set-piece) https://t.co/zy2TpwemWr
